fichas.title: Cleaning Buildings: Façade Hoists and Mobile Equipment
fichas.summary: Guidance on safe access and equipment for cleaning windows and façades, including suspended ladders, maintenance gangways, cleaning platforms, and mobile work-platform hoists. The page also lists recommended window-cleaning intervals by building type and glazing location.
fichas.building_type: Buildings with windows and façades requiring cleaning and maintenance

Cleaning of adjacent windows

Shading shows acceptable cleaning

surface area

Fac;:ade hoists and mobile equipment (allowing access to fixed
glazing) for cleaning windows and fagades---> 0- G) are available
to carry out maintenance and repair work (thus saving the cost
of scaffolding). If fitted at the right time, they can also be used
to carry out minor building work (such as fixing blinds, installing
windows etc.). With slight modifications, fac;:ade hoists and access
equipment can be used as rescue apparatus in the event of a fire.
The options available include mobile suspended ladders mounted
on rails, trackless roof gantry equipment with a cradle, and a railmounted roof gantry with a cradle and attached to the roof deck
or the balustrade, with curves and points.
Suspended light metal ladder equipment (for fagade access) ---> f)
consists of a suspended mobile ladder on rails. The width of the
ladder is 724 mm or 840 mm, and the total overall length is 25 m
maximum, depending on the shape of the building. The maximum
safe working load (S.W.L.) is 200 kg (i.e. two men and the
apparatus itself). Alternatives are available, such as maintenance
gangways---> 0 and cleaning balconies--->

e.

Fac;:ade hoists and mobile equipment (allowing access to fixed
glazing) for cleaning windows and fagades---> 0- G) are available
to carry out maintenance and repair work (thus saving the cost
of scaffolding). If fitted at the right time, they can also be used
to carry out minor building work (such as fixing blinds, installing
windows etc.). With slight modifications, fac;:ade hoists and access
equipment can be used as rescue apparatus in the event of a fire.
The options available include mobile suspended ladders mounted
on rails, trackless roof gantry equipment with a cradle, and a railmounted roof gantry with a cradle and attached to the roof deck
or the balustrade, with curves and points.
Suspended light metal ladder equipment (for fagade access) ---> f)
consists of a suspended mobile ladder on rails. The width of the
ladder is 724 mm or 840 mm, and the total overall length is 25 m
maximum, depending on the shape of the building. The maximum
safe working load (S.W.L.) is 200 kg (i.e. two men and the
apparatus itself). Alternatives are available, such as maintenance
gangways---> 0 and cleaning balconies--->
